name: Arapaho Tribe of the Wind River Reservation (United States)
description: Five horizontal stripes of red, white, black, white and red, the black centre stripe widest; a white triangle edged in black issues from the hoist and is charged with a small disc divided red, white and black.
history: Flag of the Northern Arapaho Tribe of the Wind River Reservation in Wyoming.

features.role: disc divided red, white and black
